completion_data.completion_summary: Fixed the picker sync allow-list post-filter that silently dropped all 23 core skills from Load Core syncs (directory-name vs. basename key mismatch), generalizing the fix to any directory-shaped category and adding a total-wipeout detector plus a permanent regression spec. memory_candidates.content: When a sync/deploy allow-list filter silently drops a whole category, the DEPLOYED tree can still look fully populated even months later, because the filter only blocks future replace/copy -- it never deletes existing files. Diffing pre- vs post-redeploy directory listings alone will show zero missing entries and can look like a false alarm; the real signal is whether the pre-fix CODE PATH (traced/scratch-tested) returns a nonzero pre-filter scan count but a zero post-filter count for that category. Don't conclude 'nothing is broken' just because the live deployed directory already has everything -- verify against an isolated scratch tree instead of the live tree.

Neovim's M.load_all_globally-style interactive sync entry points that call vim.fn.confirm(...) can be driven non-interactively from a headless nvim --headless -c "luafile ..." script by overriding vim.fn.confirm = function(...) return N end before calling the public function -- this works because vim.fn's metatable only implements __index, so assigning a field directly shadows the dynamic vimscript-function dispatch for subsequent lookups. Useful whenever the only public/exported entry point that performs a mutation is gated behind an interactive confirm dialog and there is no lower-level unexported function to call instead.

reflection.what_worked: Re-deriving the Phase 2 category survey directly from the current manifest and source (rather than trusting the research report's numbers verbatim) caught a stale premise: scripts/tests and scripts/lint ARE now declared in provides.scripts (as path-prefixed strings), contradicting the research's 'absent/undeclared' framing, and a live read-only scan confirmed they still silently fail via a third, distinct mismatch mechanism.
reflection.what_was_hard: Driving the picker's interactive 'Load Core' confirm dialog non-interactively for the Phase 6 deliberate redeploy required discovering that execute_sync is a private, unexported closure, so the only path to the real write was through load_all_globally with vim.fn.confirm stubbed.
reflection.what_was_missed: None substantive -- all 6 phases completed with their full verification tiers satisfied.
reflection.successes: All 6 plan phases completed and verified: scratch-tree reproduction confirmed the hard-gate hypothesis exactly, the generalized filter and wipeout detector both pass their scratch-tree harnesses, the new sync_spec.lua regression spec was proven to actually guard the defect via a deliberate revert-and-restore cycle, and the one sanctioned Load Core redeploy synced 295 artifacts with zero detector warnings and both hand-corrected orchestrator SKILL.md files verified byte-identical to source before and after.
